## About
Vegas Valley Fleet & Auto is family owned and operated. After many years of experience, the Krshul brothers came together to offer what real people and companies need: quality service and friendly people. We're born and raised in the Las Vegas Valley, and we treat everyone like our family and neighbor.
We're your dealership alternative. Whether your gas, diesel or hybrid vehicle needs a simple tune-up or a complete major overhaul, our ASE Certified technicians work on foreign and domestic cars and trucks. Fleet work is a big part of what we do, and we maintain a great number of local fleets.
We don't offer impossibly low prices or unrealistic promises. We do promise quality maintenance and repair you can count on. Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 53 Google reviews.

## Services
- Fleet Service: Service and repairs that keep your business vehicles on the road.
- Brakes: Brake maintenance and repair so your vehicle stops when you step on the pedal.
- Suspension and Steering: Inspection and repair of the parts that keep your ride steady and your steering true.
- Diesel Service and Repair: Service and repair for diesel cars and trucks.
- Engine Performance and Repair: From a simple tune-up to a major engine repair.
- Complete Diagnostic Services: We find the problem and give you options before any work starts.
- Tire Sales and Service: Tire replacement right here at the shop.
- Custom metal fabrication: For your vehicle, your projects or your business, we will make it for you.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Gas, diesel and hybrid vehicles, foreign and domestic, cars and trucks, from a simple tune-up to a complete major overhaul.

Q: Can I keep my factory warranty if I bring my car here?
A: Yes. We perform your warranty required maintenance while maintaining your factory warranty requirements.

Q: Who will I talk to at the shop?
A: One longtime customer says to ask for Nick, Matt or Jimmy, and mentions Natalie up front, who greets you with a smile and pencils you in.
